note: docs/architecture/velocity_channel.md section 8. stage: STAND_TEST (wheels off the ground; needs estop, dead_man, owner_killed, usb_unplugged, orin_power_cut), GROUND_TEST (adds software_zero and auto_stand_checks), SUPERVISED_CLOSED_LOOP (adds braking rows at the approved top speed for every path: software_zero <= 0.18 m, the others <= 0.30 m, at least 5 trials, scatter <= 20 %, heading change <= 5 deg). hold_to_run_switch: installed true, or installed false with the user's decision in words, decided_by user and decided_at; not installed drops the dead_man test and braking path. owner_killed, usb_unplugged and orin_power_cut need max_stop_time_s no more than communication_timeout_s + 0.5 s. Speeds go one step at a time: linear 0.10, 0.20, 0.30 m/s, angular 0.30, 0.40, 0.50 rad/s; the next linear step needs braking rows (GROUND_TEST) or a passed closed_loop_runs entry (SUPERVISED_CLOSED_LOOP) at the step below. Register addresses and expected values stay empty until the ZLAC8030D manual is checked; this template must be rejected.
